_comment: PUT /repos/{owner}/{repo}/branches/main/protection payload. Applied by tools/create-github-repo.ps1. Every change to main has to arrive as a pull request with all required checks green; nobody, admins included, can push or rewrite main directly. Solo maintainer mode: required_approving_review_count is 0 and code-owner review is off, because GitHub never lets an author approve their own pull request. Raise those two - and require_last_push_approval - once a second maintainer exists; see REVIEW_POLICY.md.
